    nanoseconds_remainder = nanoseconds % 1_000_000_000
    microseconds = nanoseconds_remainder // 1000

    minutes = (total_seconds_in_day % 3600) // 60
    seconds = total_seconds_in_day % 60
    return datetime.time(hour=hours, minute=minutes, second=seconds, microsecond=microseconds, tzinfo=tz)
